Agent Name: FileSurfer
Step Number: 10
Reason for Mistake: The FileSurfer agent failed to execute the command to extract and display the content of page 11 from the local file. Despite receiving clear instructions multiple times to navigate to page 11, locate the second-to-last paragraph, and report the date, it repeatedly responded with the same "Download complete" message and the viewport showing "Page 1 of 1" instead of actually reading the file and providing the requested text. This failure to perform the core task of reading the specific page led the Orchestrator to eventually guess the answer "23" rather than deriving it from the source material, resulting in the wrong solution.
